attempts.summary: Deployed a 3-member etcd cluster (v3.6.10, Alpine apk package) across node1/node2/node3, wrote application keys, simulated permanent loss of the node3 member by stopping etcd and wiping its data directory, then removed the dead member and added a fresh replacement member on node3 which rejoined and resynced via raft. Verified 3/3 healthy members and all keys intact. Completed the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol: restarted node1, node2, then node3 one at a time via native reboot, proved changed boot_id on each, and confirmed etcd auto-recovery, quorum, and data integrity after each restart.
